name: Manik Saha
profileSummary: Manik Saha is an Indian politician serving as the Chief Minister of Tripura and leader of the house in the Tripura Legislative Assembly. He has represented the Town Bordowali Assembly constituency in the Tripura Legislative Assembly since 26 June 2022. He was also a member of the Rajya Sabha from Tripura in 2022 until he became Chief Minister, and the President of Bharatiya Janata Party, Tripura from 2020 to 2022. He has been a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party since 2016 and was a member of the Indian National Congress before 2016.
